use_case_summary: Primary: conversational support assistant (multi-tenant within product) with embeddings-backed doc search and reranking for answers. Must serve interactive chat with <200ms median generation latency for short queries and solid throughput for overnight batch embedding jobs.
requirements_summary: Latency SLO: median <200ms token generation for chat; p95 <450ms. Throughput: steady-state 20 qps, peak burst up to 60 qps for product events. Embedding batch: 5M vectors/month. Data residency: US only. Security: SSO + audit logs; customer-managed keys (KMS); retention controls. Routing: want deterministic routing to Dedicated pool with fallback to hosted cheaper model under capacity pressure.
pricing_proposal: Redwood initial term sheet: three committed tiers — Bronze: 50M tokens/mo commit ($12k/mo), Silver: 150M tokens/mo ($30k/mo), Gold: 300M tokens/mo ($55k/mo). Burst allowance: 2x committed tokens for Gold, 1.5x for Silver, 1.2x for Bronze over a 24-hour window. Overage: billed at 1.6x unit rate for first 10% over commit, then 2.0x thereafter. Ramp schedule offer: 3-month ramp to final commit with linear billing and pro-rata credits if usage below commit in month 1-2. Pelmere counter: wants Gold-level performance at ~20% discount and a guaranteed 4x burst during product launches for first 6 months.
